data.what_it_does: Provides a flexible scrollbar with customizable thumb, line, and label via builders. It supports dragging, auto visibility, and various layout options.
use_when: Need a scrollbar with custom appearance
Want a label that follows the thumb
avoid_when: Only need the default Flutter Scrollbar
strengths: Supports dragging, auto visibility, and label positioning
weaknesses: Limited documentation on performance and edge cases
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package
